Pete Levin was born in Boston on December 20, 1942. His diverse career has included performing on French horn or keyboards with artists ranging from Paul Simon to the Boston Symphony Orchestra. Pete has become well known in the music business as a creative composer and synthesist and his music is heard in numerous television and film scores.
Pete was interviewed in Danbury, Connecticut on November 20, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
